import math

sys.AddBody(pend_1)
pend_1.SetFixed(False)  # The pendulum can move
pend_1.EnableCollision(False)  # Disable collision detection for the pendulum
pend_1.SetMass(1)  # Set the mass of the pendulum (in kg)
pend_1.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVector3d(0.2, 1, 1))  # Set the inertia tensor (in kg·m^2)

# Add a visualization cylinder to the pendulum

pend_1.AddVisualShape(cyl_1, chrono.ChFramed(chrono.VNULL, chrono.QuatFromAngleY(chrono.CH_PI_2)))

# Set the initial position of the pendulum (center of mass) in the absolute frame

pend_1.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(1, 0, 1))

# Create a revolute joint to connect the pendulum to the ground

rev_1 = chrono.ChLinkLockRevolute()
rev_1.Initialize(ground, pend_1, chrono.ChFramed(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1), chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)))
sys.AddLink(rev_1)

# Create the Irrlicht visualization system
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()

vis.AddTypicalLights()  # Add typical lights for better visualization

# Simulation loop

while vis.Run():
    vis.BeginScene()  # Begin the scene for rendering
    vis.Render()  # Render the scene
    vis.EndScene()  # End the scene

    # Log information after 1 second of simulation time

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# 1. Initialize the Chrono system and create the physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# 2. Create the Irrlicht application for visualization
application = irr.ChIrrApp(system, "Simple Pendulum Simulation", irr.dimension2du(800, 600))
application.SetSkyBox()
application.SetLights()
application.SetCamera(irr.vector3df(0, 1, 3))
application.AssetBindAll()
application.AssetUpdateAll()

# 3. Create the ground body
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(2, 0.1, 2, 1000, True, True)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -0.05, 0))
ground.SetBodyFixed(True)
system.Add(ground)

# 4. Create the pendulum bob
mass = 1.0  # kg
radius = 0.1  # meters
inertia = chrono.ChMatrix33D()
# For a solid sphere, inertia can be approximated as (2/5)*m*r^2
inertia_value = (2/5) * mass * radius**2
inertia = chrono.ChMatrix33D()
inertia.FillDiagonal(inertia_value, inertia_value, inertia_value)

pendulum = chrono.ChBodyEasySphere(radius, 1000, True, True)
pendulum.SetMass(mass)
pendulum.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(inertia_value, inertia_value, inertia_value))
pendulum.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -1, 0))
system.Add(pendulum)

# 5. Create a revolute joint (hinge) connecting the pendulum to the ground
pivot_point = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0)
revolute = chrono.ChLinkLockRevolute()
revolute.Initialize(ground, pendulum, chrono.ChCoordsysD(pivot_point, chrono.Q_from_AngX(0)))
system.Add(revolute)

# 6. Set initial conditions for the pendulum (e.g., initial angle)
initial_angle_deg = 30
initial_angle_rad = chrono.CH_C_PI / 6  # 30 degrees in radians
pendulum.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -1, 0))
pendulum.SetRot(chrono.Q_from_AngX(initial_angle_rad))
# Optional: give an initial angular velocity
pendulum.SetW(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))

# 7. Configure the simulation parameters
system.SetSolverType(chrono.ChSolver.SolverType_SOR)
system.SetMaxItersSolverSpeed(100)
system.SetTimestep(0.001)

# 8. Initialize the Irrlicht application
application.AssetBindAll()
application.AssetUpdateAll()

# 9. Simulation loop with periodic logging
import math
import time

print("Starting simulation...")
simulation_time = 0
end_time = 10  # seconds
log_interval = 0.1  # seconds
next_log_time = 0

while application.GetDevice().run() and simulation_time < end_time:
    # Advance the simulation
    system.DoStepDynamics(system.GetTimestep())
    simulation_time += system.GetTimestep()

    # Log data at specified intervals
    if simulation_time >= next_log_time:
        # Get pendulum position and velocity
        pos = pendulum.GetPos()
        vel = pendulum.GetW()
        print(f"Time: {simulation_time:.2f}s | Position: ({pos.x:.3f}, {pos.y:.3f}, {pos.z:.3f}) | "
              f"Angular velocity: ({vel.x:.3f}, {vel.y:.3f}, {vel.z:.3f})")
        next_log_time += log_interval

    # Render the scene
    application.BeginScene()
    application.DrawAll()
    application.EndScene()

    # Sleep briefly to limit CPU usage
    time.sleep(0.001)

print("Simulation finished.")
```
